observation.command:
cd /workspace
echo "=== Which modules declare a dependency on geocoder? ==="
grep -rln "'geocoder:geocoder'\|geocoder:geocoder" --include="*.info.yml" web/modules web/profiles profile 2>/dev/null | grep -v "web/modules/contrib/geocoder"
echo "=== geocoder's own info deps ==="
awk '/^dependencies:/{f=1;next} /^[a-z_]+:/{if(f)exit} f' web/modules/contrib/geocoder/geocoder.info.yml
echo ""
echo "=== CI files ==="
ls -la .gitlab/ 2>/dev/null
find .gitlab -type f 2>/dev/null
echo "=== Look for how CI installs (drush site:install / composer install) ==="
grep -rn "site:install\|composer install\|ddev" .gitlab/ scripts/ 2>/dev/null | head
